title: Pure Angelechy
summary: Angelechy cards with generic hand traps and staples. Every Angelechy Main Deck card is a Spell or Trap: they summon the Synchro pieces straight from the Extra Deck and park others in the Spell & Trap Zone as Continuous Spells, where each one has its own passive effect. Opening to e4 can be activated from the hand on the opponent's first turn. The Beyond the Brave cards lead: Strategy Score searches the Spells/Traps, Endgame Problem grows with every piece in your back row, and Verdict banishes the opponent's whole field once five pieces are out. Opening to e4, Strategy Score and Opposition lock the Extra Deck to Synchros, so the Extra Deck is all Angelechy.
main: Trap you can flip from the hand on their first turn: places a Field Spell, summons a Level 2 or 7 piece, and parks another.
Newest support. Searches an Angelechy Spell/Trap; from the GY, returns a parked piece to the Extra Deck to summon it.
Field Spell: discards a Spell/Trap to summon a Level 2 piece and park another; rebuilds when a piece is destroyed.
Newest support. Field Spell that grows with your parked pieces: draws, picks their zones, and at four banishes what they summon.
Newest support. Summons one piece to their field and parks another; from the GY, shuffles five Angelechy cards back.
Newest support. Returns a parked piece to summon it; from the GY, swaps an Angelechy card for a new piece.
Newest support. Negates a card, or with five pieces out banishes their whole field; from the GY, parks another piece.
Gives them a piece to negate the cards next to it; from the GY, searches an Angelechy Spell/Trap.
extra: Level 2 Synchro Tuner: banishes a monster and jumps to their side, then returns to call another piece.
Level 10: banishes a monster; parked, searches a Trap and caps their monster effects at five a turn.
Level 8: banishes a card in its column; parked, places Shatranga and protects your other Angelechy cards.
Level 7: banishes a monster in another column; parked, searches a Spell and burns for each of their activations.
Newest support. Level 7: banishes a card two columns over; parked, mills an Angelechy card and limits each Chain to one activation per player.
Newest support. DARK Level 10: each player summons a Fairy Synchro; changes sides when an Angelechy attacks it.
